correctness.rationale: For all 65535 nonempty binary four-mer sets, exact Hamiltonian-path overlap DP yields the true optimal superstring length. The published endpoint-overlap lemma and an explicit minimum-compression recursion enumerate every ordered maximum-overlap Greedy tie. Reversal and complementation reduce to exactly 16959 representatives. Standalone exact-integer C++17 verification of the complete finite domain finds maximum 17/11 and one representative orbit; direct literal-word recursion independently certifies the maximizing example, and explicit length-17 Greedy and optimal length-11 witnesses meet lower-bound length.

originality.rationale: No inspected published claim, relevant database result, or accessible prior local finding implies the sharp global 17/11 approximation constant and exactly four equality inputs for all 65535 binary four-mer subsets. All relevant qualifiers have been compared; residual risk is an unindexed equivalence or inaccessible detailed 2015 proceedings text.

The sharp universal adversarial Greedy approximation ratio and equality classification give an exact performance guarantee for string/spectrum assembly, not obtainable from the previous eight-read example or the general ratio-two theorem.
